description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
